assumptions.choice: The highest high and lowest low use the 10 completed bars preceding the signal bar.
assumptions.reason: Including the current bar would make a close-above-high or close-below-low breakout impossible with standard OHLC bars.

assumptions.choice: The stop uses the ATR value available when the entry order completes and the actual executed entry price.
assumptions.reason: This is the closest literal implementation of a stop placed 2 ATR from entry.

assumptions.choice: Protective stop orders are submitted after entry completion and therefore become eligible on subsequent backtrader bar processing.
assumptions.reason: With a single 5-minute OHLCV feed, the harness cannot model an independently active stop during the same bar in which a market entry fills.
